Sustainable Development

Achieving sustainable development is the key to a brighter future. It means balancing economic growth, environmental conservation and social equality. Let us work together to build a future that is sustainable for everybody.

Our programmes @@HTML_CONTENT@@

Free Legal Advice

People who cannot afford a lawyer can get free legal counsel from us. Talk to us about your situation and we will help you understand and protect your rights.

Get legal help @@HTML_CONTENT@@

Legal Clinics

Our legal clinics offer free or low-cost legal assistance to people who cannot afford standard legal representation, including help with housing, work and family law.

Visit a clinic @@HTML_CONTENT@@

Good Governance

Good governance is the set of rules, procedures and processes that guide an institution. It ensures openness, accountability and ethical behaviour, in companies and in public life.

Learn more @@HTML_CONTENT@@

Health and Safety

Maintain a healthy lifestyle and put your well-being first. We promote health and safety at home, at work and in our communities.

Learn more @@HTML_CONTENT@@

The Murdock Emisembe Foundation is a non-governmental organisation registered in Kenya. We work with communities to promote good governance, human rights and access to justice.

Through free legal advice, legal clinics, education and health initiatives, we help people understand and claim their rights, and we push for institutions that are open, accountable and fair.

What we do Get involved

Our programmes focus on the issues that shape people's daily lives and their rights.

@@HTML_SECTION@@

Good Governance

Good governance is crucial for every society's progress. It means openness, accountability and citizen engagement in decision-making.

Watch The Emisembe Report @@HTML_CONTENT@@

Human Rights

Human rights belong to all people, regardless of colour, gender or religion. They include the right to life, liberty and equality before the law.

@@HTML_CONTENT@@

Education

Education is the key to realising one's full potential. It enables people to make informed decisions and to take an active part in society.

@@HTML_CONTENT@@

Relief of Poverty

Fighting poverty demands immediate attention. Governments, organisations and citizens must work together to support those in need.

@@HTML_CONTENT@@

Health and Safety

Health and safety matter in every home and workplace. Everyone deserves protection from hazards and accidents.

@@HTML_CONTENT@@

Environment

The environment is crucial to our survival. We protect it by reducing pollution, conserving resources and promoting sustainability.
